parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module's established way to reach persistence is through injected repository-style stores: BoxOffice depends on EventStore and TicketStore and maps rows into the domain types Event and Ticket. GateLog ignores that abstraction. It injects PrismaService and runs ORM queries itself (prisma.scan.create, prisma.scan.findMany), building record shapes inline and aggregating raw rows. That is reaching persistence around the module's repository/port pattern, so the abstraction is inconsistent across the two files. Scan handling is also split: BoxOffice.admit records scans through TicketStore.markScanned, while GateLog.scanned writes a separate scan record directly through Prisma. As a lesser point, BoxOffice copies the same row-to-Event construction into both purchase and listing.

violations.message: GateLog bypasses the module's store/repository abstraction (EventStore/TicketStore pattern used by BoxOffice) and uses PrismaService directly: prisma.scan.create in scanned() and prisma.scan.findMany in busiestGate().

The row-to-Event construction `new Event(data.id, data.title, data.venueCapacity, data.seatsSold, data.startsAt, data.priceCents)` is copied in both purchase() and listing() instead of coming from one shared mapping.
